subject.title: fix: deliver sessions_yield message on empty-payload turns

question: Should `sessions_yield.message` remain hidden continuation context, or become a user-visible acknowledgment contract?
rationale: The field shipped with hidden semantics, while this PR exposes it directly; selecting the permanent model-facing contract and compatibility path requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit acknowledgment field
options.body: Keep `message` hidden and add a clearly named optional user-visible field carried through both harnesses and the canonical reply pipeline.

options.title: Redefine message as visible
options.body: Intentionally migrate `message` to user-visible semantics with updated schema wording, documentation, compatibility analysis, and live delivery proof.

options.title: Generate a generic acknowledgment
options.body: Keep all yield context hidden and let OpenClaw emit a fixed product-owned acknowledgment when background work begins.

recommendation.title: Add explicit acknowledgment field
recommendation.body: Keep `message` hidden and add a clearly named optional user-visible field carried through both harnesses and the canonical reply pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most directly to the original tool and its hidden-message semantics.
